briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.1%, S&P500 +0.3%), so we held cash on the other two open slots rather than forcing trades. TOST stood out with all four confirming technical signals, so we added it as a high-conviction buy while letting existing positions ride.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade when several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, moving averages, and volume — all point the same direction at once. Relying on just one signal can give false alarms, but when they all align, it's a stronger sign that real buying interest is behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「多重訊號確認」指的是只有當多個獨立技術指標（例如RSI、MACD、均線及成交量）同時顯示一致方向時才採取交易行動。單一訊號容易出現假訊號，但當所有指標同步確認時，就更有力地反映背後存在真實的買盤支持。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially sideways today, with the NASDAQ up just 0.1% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off driver, investors appeared to stay cautious, rotating selectively into names showing concrete technical strength rather than broadly chasing the market. This kind of low-volatility, range-bound session often follows a period of larger moves as participants wait for the next data point or earnings catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市大致橫行整理，納指僅升0.1%，標普500升0.3%，反映市場缺乏明顯方向性消息刺激。在沒有清晰的風險偏好或風險規避訊號下，投資者普遍保持審慎，資金傾向流向具備實質技術面強勢的個股，而非全面追高大市。這種低波動、區間徘徊的交易日，通常出現在大幅波動後，市場等待下一個數據或業績消息的階段。

trades.reasoning: Only candidate with full four-signal confirmation (RSI bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover, histogram rising, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge), indicating genuine institutional participation even on an otherwise neutral day.
